prompt: IMPORTANT - how the cat must look: a REAL LIVING CAT filmed by a television camera. Individual hairs visible, natural slightly messy fur with real texture, real whiskers, a normal cat eye with a proper iris and pupil, a damp nose. It must NOT look computer generated, NOT smooth, NOT glossy, NOT cartoonish, NOT like a plush toy, and it must NOT have oversized round eyes. Same film grain, same lighting and same softness as the rest of the broadcast frame. The cat MUST REMAIN A CAT in every single frame - it never turns into a person and never loses its fur, ears, whiskers or tail. The female fighter stays turned AWAY from the camera for the whole shot - we see her from behind, her braid and her back. Her face is NEVER visible to the camera at any moment, she never turns around. Plain live television look. No sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring, the pre-fight staredown. NOBODY THROWS A PUNCH. SECONDS 0-2: the giant cat stands on the right facing her, she stands on the left with her back to the camera. The cat is upright on its hind legs, perfectly still, staring at her. SECONDS 2-4: they lean in toward each other until the cat's muzzle is almost touching her face, both filling the middle of the frame. SECONDS 4-8: they hold the staredown. The cat does not blink and does not move, only whiskers and fur move slightly. She shifts her weight, then drops her head and turns away, still with her back to us. The cat slowly blinks once and keeps staring. The cat stays the size of a grown adult human and never drops onto all four paws. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the two of them sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Photorealistic, correct anatomy, no morphing. Comedic tone, deadpan. Audio: a huge arena crowd murmuring and building, a few whistles, then the crowd starting to laugh and roar. No music, no commentary, no speech.
